extraFacts.fact: ASME B1.20.3 is the standard for inch Dryseal pipe threads (NPTF), which are made to seal on the thread.
ASME B1.20.1 is the general-purpose inch pipe thread standard; it covers tapered NPT and straight NPSM pipe threads.
extraFacts.source: ASME B1.20.1, Pipe Threads, General Purpose (Inch)

faqs.q: What is the Dixon Hex Plugs and where is it used?
